messages.subject: Storm warning
messages.body: Aurora, Earth desk. Historical source received and labelled. Particle observations are rising. Start your shelter planning now; I will relay what we see as long as the link holds.

messages.subject: A labelled what-if
messages.body: This storm replays the real July 2012 event that hit the STEREO-A spacecraft, as if it had struck the Moon. The data is real; the strike on Aurora is a labelled counterfactual.

messages.subject: Everyone reads
messages.body: Observations are on the table with their source label. Each of you reads the part the others need. Then we size the shelter for five.

messages.subject: Your plan
messages.body: Your plan, cadets. I retain command responsibility.

messages.subject: Five seats
messages.body: April's card counted four. Today it must count five: breathing, food and shelter places all change. Five seat markers are on the shelter diagram.

messages.subject: Not our whole life support
messages.body: The plants matter, but they are not our whole life-support system. Size the air and food for five people first.

messages.subject: One schedule
messages.body: Four good ideas collided: power margin, circulation, warm roots, full shielding. Now it is one schedule with every dependency, including when the borrowed water returns.

messages.subject: Return time
messages.body: The return-water time is written into the plan: after the last exposure step, not before, and not forgotten.

messages.subject: Fifteen and fifteen
messages.body: Seed case latched in the shelter: fifteen and fifteen, thirty founders. The twelve from Alo's first harvest are already growing in the garden.

messages.subject: Valves
messages.body: Name the valve, then touch it. Bundles stay through the last exposure.

messages.subject: Everyone inside
messages.body: Five names called, five answers on the local channel. Both hatch indications agree. A chair icon is not proof; your voices are.

messages.subject: Here
messages.body: Here. Protected branch checked. Guide light on, small and steady.

messages.subject: First wave checked
messages.body: Steps 1 and 2 matched the forecast: energy, atmosphere, food, garden telemetry. First wave checked, not merely endured. We are in the lull.

messages.subject: Garden on local data
messages.body: The living garden is still reporting on local telemetry. Roots warm enough. I will open the archive player while we wait.

messages.subject: Last recovered log
messages.body: Expedition Zero's final recording, stored locally. It is a historical archive: it does not cross the current storm or open the Earth link.

messages.subject: A hope, not a prediction
messages.body: She called the seeds Alo, light. The name was a hope, not a prediction. Four steps left; the next one needs checking, not courage.

messages.subject: Four steps left
messages.body: Four steps left. Our report needs more than a good line. It needs the next checked step.

messages.subject: Final line on the chart
messages.body: Peak passed in steps 3 and 4; the shield did what we predicted. Final exposure first, then the water went home. Rao has not answered since the last step.

messages.subject: No reply
messages.body: Earth link quiet. Before we call every radio broken, we test what still works.

messages.subject: Local pass, external fail
messages.body: Local network passes; the direct dish path and the external feedthrough fail. I saved the relay-bypass diagram. Two clear readings before anyone prepares to go outside.

messages.subject: Isolation
messages.body: Correct isolation was still the right decision. We have local procedures and stores.

messages.subject: Ordinary days
messages.body: The garden needs ordinary days too. Care, food, atmosphere and observation run on the stable-operation board with no reply from Earth in the plan. Rafi is opening the spare controller from December.

messages.subject: My note
messages.body: The spare controller still has my compatibility note clipped inside. Past me was helpful. Rare.

messages.subject: Make the road hear us
messages.body: Controller checked against the Malapert service housing; repeaters packed for every neighbouring link. A bench pass is not field verification, so the route and the kit go together.

messages.subject: Packed
messages.body: Equipment packed and the surveyed route loaded. Next: who goes and who stays with the garden.

messages.subject: Departure board
messages.body: Kai and Rafi with me. Mei and Amara hold Aurora. Duplicate checklists at both boards. We leave at 00:00 on the 8th.

messages.subject: Small guide light
messages.body: Kai asked us to keep the small guide light. It is already in the plan.
